```rust
use crate::workflow::indexed::IndexRejection;

/// Original durable semantic status; operational failure is unrepresentable here.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RetainedStatus {
    /// Original command was accepted, including source legacy no-op/empty claim.
    Accepted,
    /// Original deterministic rejection is replayed without current guard checks.
    Rejected(BatchRejection),
    /// Original validated policy business rejection, without operational failures.
    PolicyRejected(PolicyRejection),
    /// Original canonical index guard rejection.
    IndexedRejected(IndexRejection),
    /// Original business-only claim rejection, without operational authority errors.
    ClaimRejected(ClaimRejection),
}

/// Policy error admitted for retention only when it is a business decision.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct PolicyRejection(PolicyError);
impl PolicyRejection {
    /// Validates that authority/preparation failures cannot become durable status.
    ///
    /// # Errors
    /// Rejects operational policy failures.
    pub const fn new(error: PolicyError) -> Result<Self, RequestValueError> {
        if error.is_apply_failure() {
            Err(RequestValueError::OperationalStatus)

            Ok(Self(error))
        }
    }

        self.0

    pub original_position: LogIdentity,
    /// Original execution time.
    pub original_time: TimestampMillis,

    pub status: RetainedStatus,

///
/// Holds immutable versioned actual bytes so replay never serializes changed
/// current records. Future apply persists this with records/indexes/history and
/// checkpoint; constructing it does not establish that persistence happened.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RetainedOutcome {
    pub(super) scope: RequestScope,
    pub(super) request: RequestId,
    pub(super) intent: ClientIntent,
    pub(super) original_position: LogIdentity,
    pub(super) original_time: TimestampMillis,
    pub(super) expires_at: TimestampMillis,
    status: RetainedStatus,

    pub(super) response: Vec<u8>,
}

impl RetainedOutcome {

    ///

    pub fn new(
        metadata: RetainedMetadata,
        response_version: u16,
        response: Vec<u8>,

    ) -> Result<Self, RequestValueError> {

            scope,
            request,
            intent,
            original_position,
            original_time,
            expires_at,
            status,

            original_time,
            expires_at,
            status,

    /// Reads the original client intent, independently of log position.

    /// Reads immutable retained response format version.

/// Primitive retained/intent construction error; no outcome persistence occurs.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RequestValueError {
    /// Intent or retained response format is unsupported.
    UnsupportedVersion,
    /// Retention expiry must be later than original execution time.
    InvalidExpiry,
    /// Actual retained response exceeds the immutable aggregate bound.
    ResponseTooLarge,
    /// Operational apply failure must not be retained as business status.
    OperationalStatus,
}

impl fmt::Display for RequestValueError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        formatter.write_str(match self {
            Self::UnsupportedVersion => "unsupported workflow request format version",
            Self::InvalidExpiry => "invalid original workflow outcome retention deadline",
            Self::ResponseTooLarge => "retained workflow response byte budget exceeded",
            Self::OperationalStatus => "operational failure is not a retained workflow outcome",
        })
    }
}
impl std::error::Error for RequestValueError {}
```

```rust
//! Closed original core-Patch frame preparation and paid borrowed verification.

use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use wf_domain::policy::complete::{
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchCaller, CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader,
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestInput, CompletePolicyEncodingError, CompletePolicyRequestError,
    PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits, ScannedCorePatchFrame,
    prepare_complete_core_policy_patch_frame_caller,
    restore_complete_core_policy_patch_frame_header, scan_complete_core_policy_patch_frame,

use wf_domain::workflow::request::gate::CommittedHeader;

mod decode;

pub use apply::{CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestPlan, decide_complete_core_policy_patch_frame};
pub use decode::{DecodedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame, decode_complete_core_policy_patch_frame};

/// Verified original bytes and their restored private request header.
///
/// The header and hashes are mathematical preparation, not ordered authority.
pub struct VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame<'a> {
    header: CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'a>,
    digest: PreparedDigest,
    isolation: Vec<u8>,
}

impl<'a> VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame<'a> {
    /// Borrows the complete immutable input without a copied frame.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn encoded(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.header.encoded()
    }

    /// Borrows the original partial command without materializing a policy.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn original_intent(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.header.original_intent()
    }

    /// Reads the recomputed identity of the complete frame.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn digest(&self) -> PreparedDigest {
        self.digest
    }

    /// Borrows the canonical isolation bytes owned by this result.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn isolation_scope(&self) -> &[u8] {
        &self.isolation
    }

    /// Joins a separately supplied log identity to verified frame identity.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn header(&self, log: LogIdentity) -> CommittedHeader<'_> {
        CommittedHeader {
            format_version: 1,
            scope: self.header.scope(),
            request: self.header.request(),
            intent: self.header.intent(),
            identity: EntryIdentity::new(log, self.digest),
            stamp: self.header.stamp(),
            encoded_entry: self.header.encoded(),
            encoded_isolation_scope: &self.isolation,
        }
    }
}

/// Verifies original tag-five bytes on the caller's continuous schema account.
///
/// No partial policy is expanded and no current state or request gate is read.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves structural, profile, work, intent and fallible scope-output refusals.
pub fn verify_complete_core_policy_patch_frame<'a>(
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    verify_frame(encoded, limits, admission, charge)
}

fn verify_frame<'a>(
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let scanned = scan_complete_core_policy_patch_frame(encoded, limits, admission, charge)?;
    let recomputed = hash_original_intent(&scanned);
    let header = restore_complete_core_policy_patch_frame_header(
        scanned, recomputed, limits, admission, charge,
    )?;
    let isolation = emit_scope(&header)?;
    let digest = hash_frame(header.encoded());
    Ok(VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame {
        header,
        digest,
        isolation,
    })
}

fn hash_original_intent(scanned: &ScannedCorePatchFrame<'_>) -> [u8; 32] {
    Sha256::digest(scanned.original_intent()).into()
}

fn emit_scope(
    header: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader<'_>,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    keys::scope([
        header.scope().tenant().as_bytes(),
        header.scope().group().as_bytes(),
        header.scope().recovery().as_bytes(),
    ])
    .map_err(|error| match error {
        CodecError::ScopeLimit => CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit,
        CodecError::LengthOverflow => PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow.into(),
        CodecError::Allocation => CompletePolicyEncodingError::AllocationFailure.into(),
        CodecError::ByteLimit | CodecError::ValueLimit => {
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into()
        }
        _ => CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into(),
    })
}

fn hash_frame(encoded: &[u8]) -> PreparedDigest {
    PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(encoded).into())
}

/// Prepares exact original core-Patch frame bytes under one continuous account.
///
/// Freshly admits raw owned input; no merged policy value replaces partial identity.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves profile, work, scope, intent/frame caps and fallible output refusal.
pub fn prepare_complete_core_policy_patch_frame(
    input: CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestInput,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<PreparedBytes, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let (caller, intent_bytes, frame_bytes) =
        prepare_complete_core_policy_patch_frame_caller(input, limits, admission, charge)?;
    let intent_digest = hash_core_patch_intent(&caller)?;
    let bytes = emit_core_patch_frame(&caller, &intent_digest, intent_bytes, frame_bytes)?;
    let digest = hash_frame(&bytes);
    Ok(PreparedBytes { bytes, digest })
}

fn emit_core_patch_frame(
    caller: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchCaller,
    intent_digest: &[u8; 32],
    intent_bytes: usize,
    frame_bytes: usize,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let mut writer = Writer::allocate(frame_bytes, frame_bytes).map_err(map_codec_error)?;
    write_core_patch_frame_header(caller, intent_digest, intent_bytes, &mut writer)
        .map_err(map_codec_error)?;
    write_core_patch_intent(caller, &mut writer)?;
    if writer.len() != frame_bytes {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::EncodingMismatch.into());
    }
    writer.finish().map_err(map_codec_error)
}

fn write_core_patch_frame_header(
    caller: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchCaller,
    intent_digest: &[u8; 32],
    intent_bytes: usize,
    writer: &mut Writer<'_>,
) -> Result<(), CodecError> {
    let input = caller.input();
    writer.write(b"FWCP")?;
    writer.u16(1)?;
    writer.byte(5)?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().tenant().as_bytes(), 8_192)?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().group().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().recovery().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    writer.raw(input.request().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    writer.u16(2)?;
    writer.write(intent_digest)?;
    writer.u64(input.stamp().hlc().physical().get())?;
    writer.u16(input.stamp().hlc().logical())?;
    writer.u64(input.stamp().wall().get())?;
    writer.u32(u32::try_from(intent_bytes).or(Err(CodecError::LengthOverflow))?)?;
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
//! Private original core-Patch visitation for intent hashing and frame emission.

use wf_domain::policy::BackoffKind;
use wf_domain::policy::complete::{
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchCaller, CompleteCorePolicyPatchInput, CompletePolicyEncodingError,
    CompletePolicyRequestError, PolicySchemaError,
};
use wf_domain::policy::definition::{
    BackoffPatch, FieldPatch, PolicyVersion, RetryPatch, StateChange, StateMode, StatePolicyPatch,
};
use wf_domain::retention::RetentionOverride;

use super::super::{CodecError, writer::Writer};
use super::intent::IntentHasher;

mod frame;

pub use frame::{CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestPlan, decide_complete_core_policy_patch_frame};
pub use frame::{
    DecodedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame, VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame,
    decode_complete_core_policy_patch_frame, prepare_complete_core_policy_patch_frame,
    verify_complete_core_policy_patch_frame,
};

pub(super) trait CorePatchSink {
    fn write(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError>;

    fn raw(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.count(bytes.len())?;
        self.write(bytes)
    }

    fn count(&mut self, count: usize) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.u32(u32::try_from(count).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?)
    }

    fn optional(&mut self, present: bool) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.u8(u8::from(present))
    }

    fn u8(&mut self, value: u8) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.write(&[value])
    }

    fn u16(&mut self, value: u16) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.write(&value.to_be_bytes())
    }

    fn u32(&mut self, value: u32) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.write(&value.to_be_bytes())
    }

    fn u64(&mut self, value: u64) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.write(&value.to_be_bytes())
    }
}

impl CorePatchSink for IntentHasher {
    fn write(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        IntentHasher::write(self, bytes)
    }
}

impl CorePatchSink for Writer<'_> {
    fn write(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        Writer::write(self, bytes).map_err(map_codec_error)
    }
}

pub(super) fn map_codec_error(error: CodecError) -> CompletePolicyRequestError {
    match error {
        CodecError::ScopeLimit => CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit,
        CodecError::LengthOverflow => PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow.into(),
        CodecError::Allocation => CompletePolicyEncodingError::AllocationFailure.into(),
        CodecError::ByteLimit | CodecError::ValueLimit => {
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into()
        }
        _ => CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into(),
    }
}

pub(super) fn hash_core_patch_intent(
    caller: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchCaller,
) -> Result<[u8; 32], CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let mut writer = IntentHasher::new();
    write_core_patch_intent(caller, &mut writer)?;
    Ok(writer.finish())
}

pub(super) fn write_core_patch_intent<W: CorePatchSink>(
    caller: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchCaller,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let input = caller.input();
    let command = input.command();
    writer.write(b"WF-INTENT\0COMPLETE-CORE-PATCH\0V2\0")?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().tenant().as_bytes())?;
    writer.optional(command.expected_generation.is_some())?;
    if let Some(expected) = command.expected_generation {
        writer.u64(expected)?;
    }
    write_core_patch(command, writer)
}

fn write_core_patch<W: CorePatchSink>(
    command: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchInput,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.raw(&command.workflow_type)?;
    match &command.patch.version {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(version) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            write_core_patch_version(version, writer)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    match &command.patch.max_active_ms {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(maximum) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            writer.u64(*maximum)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    match &command.patch.retry {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(retry) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            write_core_patch_retry(retry, writer)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    match &command.patch.retention {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(retention) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            write_core_patch_retention(retention, writer)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    writer.count(command.patch.states.len())?;
    for (key, change) in &command.patch.states {
        writer.raw(key)?;
        match change {
            StateChange::Remove => writer.u8(0)?,
            StateChange::Patch(state) => {
                writer.u8(1)?;
                write_core_patch_state(state, writer)?;
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_core_patch_state<W: CorePatchSink>(
    state: &StatePolicyPatch,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    match &state.mode {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(mode) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            writer.u8(match mode {
                StateMode::Parallel => 0,
                StateMode::Fifo => 1,
            })?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    match &state.retry {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(retry) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            write_core_patch_retry(retry, writer)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    match &state.retention {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(retention) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            write_core_patch_retention(retention, writer)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_core_patch_version<W: CorePatchSink>(
    version: &PolicyVersion,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    match version {
        PolicyVersion::Bytes(bytes) => {
            writer.u8(0)?;
            writer.raw(bytes)
        }
        PolicyVersion::Number(number) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            writer.u64(*number)
        }
    }
}

fn write_core_patch_retry<W: CorePatchSink>(
    retry: &RetryPatch,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(retry.max_retries.is_some())?;
    if let Some(maximum) = retry.max_retries {
        writer.u16(maximum)?;
    }
    writer.optional(retry.backoff.is_some())?;
    if let Some(backoff) = &retry.backoff {
        write_core_patch_backoff(backoff, writer)?;
    }
    writer.optional(retry.exhausted_to.is_some())?;
    if let Some(target) = &retry.exhausted_to {
        writer.raw(target)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_core_patch_backoff<W: CorePatchSink>(
    backoff: &BackoffPatch,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(backoff.kind.is_some())?;
    if let Some(kind) = backoff.kind {
        writer.u8(match kind {
            BackoffKind::None => 0,
            BackoffKind::Fixed => 1,
            BackoffKind::Linear => 2,
            BackoffKind::Exponential => 3,
        })?;
    }
    writer.optional(backoff.base_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(base) = backoff.base_ms {
        writer.u64(base)?;
    }
    writer.optional(backoff.max_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(maximum) = backoff.max_ms {
        writer.u64(maximum)?;
    }
    writer.optional(backoff.jitter_pct.is_some())?;
    if let Some(jitter) = backoff.jitter_pct {
        writer.u8(jitter)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_core_patch_retention<W: CorePatchSink>(
    retention: &RetentionOverride,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(retention.ttl_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(ttl) = retention.ttl_ms {
        writer.u64(ttl)?;
    }
    writer.optional(retention.history_max_events.is_some())?;
    if let Some(maximum) = retention.history_max_events {
        writer.u32(maximum)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
pub struct CodecLimits {

    digest: PreparedDigest,
    isolation: Vec<u8>,
    state_keys: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
    claim_filters: Option<claim::ClaimFilterRefs<'a>>,
}

impl DecodedRequest<'_> {
    /// Borrows the decoded explicit values; current state still requires authority.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn request(&self) -> &PreparedRequest {
        &self.request
    }
    /// Reads a recomputed identity over exact input bytes.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn digest(&self) -> PreparedDigest {
        self.digest
    }
    /// Borrows exact input bytes; no complete canonical reencode is required.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn encoded(&self) -> &[u8] {
        self.encoded
    }
    /// Borrows actual isolation bytes derived from the decoded namespace.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn isolation_scope(&self) -> &[u8] {
        &self.isolation
    }
    /// Borrows the complete derived state key for one represented batch item.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn state_key(&self, index: usize) -> Option<&[u8]> {
        self.state_keys.get(index).map(Vec::as_slice)
    }
    /// Borrows the represented payload/result/error fields without another copy.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn value_bytes(&self, index: usize) -> Option<[Option<&[u8]>; 2]> {
        use wf_domain::workflow::Operation;

        let PreparedOperation::Batch(items) = &self.request.operation else {
            return None;
        };
        let operation = &items.get(index)?.command.operation;
        Some(match operation {
            Operation::Create(value) => [value.payload.as_deref(), None],
            Operation::Transition(value) => [value.payload.as_deref(), None],
            Operation::Complete(value) | Operation::Fail(value) => {
                [value.payload.as_deref(), value.value.as_deref()]
            }
            Operation::Retry(value) => [value.payload.as_deref(), value.error.as_deref()],
            Operation::RetryWithPolicy(value) => [value.payload.as_deref(), value.error.as_deref()],
            Operation::Cancel(value) => [value.error.as_deref(), None],
            Operation::Claim(_) | Operation::Reclaim(_) | Operation::ExtendLease(_) => [None, None],
        })
    }

    #[must_use]

            format_version: 1,
            scope: &self.request.scope,
            request: &self.request.request,
            intent: self.request.intent,
            identity: wf_domain::workflow::control::EntryIdentity::new(log, self.digest),
            stamp: self.request.stamp,
            encoded_entry: self.encoded,
            encoded_isolation_scope: &self.isolation,
        }
    }
    /// Borrows the exact decoded policy command/value and original request header.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn policy_envelope(
        &self,
        log: LogIdentity,
    ) -> Option<wf_domain::workflow::request::policy::PolicyEnvelope<'_>> {
        let PreparedOperation::InstallPolicy { command, value } = &self.request.operation else {
            return None;
        };
        Some(wf_domain::workflow::request::policy::PolicyEnvelope {
            header: self.header(log),
            command,
            prepared: value,
        })
    }
    /// Borrows physical query filters and binds separately assigned committed identity.
    /// Selection and current authority are supplied by the ordered apply owner.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn claim_envelope(
        &self,
        log: LogIdentity,
    ) -> Option<wf_domain::claim::apply::ClaimEnvelope<'_>> {
        use wf_domain::claim::PartitionFilter;
        use wf_domain::claim::apply::{ClaimEnvelope, ClaimQuery, ClaimStates};

        let PreparedOperation::ClaimPhase(phase) = &self.request.operation else {
            return None;
        };
        let filters = self.claim_filters.as_ref()?;
        Some(ClaimEnvelope {
            header: self.header(log),
            query: ClaimQuery {
                workflow_type: &phase.query.workflow_type,
                partitions: if phase.query.partitions.is_some() {
                    PartitionFilter::Only(&filters[2])
                } else {
                    PartitionFilter::Any
                },
                states: if phase.query.states.is_some() {
                    ClaimStates::Only(&filters[0])
                } else {
                    ClaimStates::Any
                },
                exclude_states: &filters[1],
                priority: phase.query.priority,
                worker: &phase.query.worker,
                lease_ms: phase.query.lease_ms,
                limit: phase.query.limit,
            },
            token_version: phase.token_version,
            first_ordinal: phase.first_ordinal,
            scan_budget: phase.scan_budget,
            head_budget: phase.head_budget,
            resume: None,
        })
    }
}

/// Operational preparation/corruption failure; never a retained business outcome.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CodecError {
    /// Private command version is unsupported.
    UnsupportedVersion,
    /// An operation/backoff discriminator is unknown.
    UnsupportedTag,
    /// A present/absent tag is neither zero nor one.
    InvalidOptionality,
    /// Fixed fields, typed identities or input continuity are invalid.
    Malformed,
    /// Bytes remain after the complete represented command.
    TrailingBytes,
    /// Complete input/output or derived-key aggregate exceeds its profile.
    ByteLimit,
    /// A batch is empty or a batch/filter count exceeds its structural profile.
    ItemLimit,
    /// A length-prefixed variable/nested field exceeds its configured byte cap.
    ValueLimit,
    /// Complete derived state key exceeds 65,535 bytes.
    KeyLimit,
    /// Complete derived isolation scope exceeds 8,192 bytes.
    ScopeLimit,
    /// A checked length/count cannot fit its explicit representation.
    LengthOverflow,
    /// A safe fallible builder reservation failed.
    Allocation,
}

impl fmt::Display for CodecError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        formatter.write_str(match self {
            Self::UnsupportedVersion => "unsupported private prepared version",
            Self::UnsupportedTag => "unsupported private prepared tag",
            Self::InvalidOptionality => "invalid private prepared optionality",
            Self::Malformed => "malformed private prepared command",
            Self::TrailingBytes => "trailing private prepared bytes",
            Self::ByteLimit => "private prepared byte budget exceeded",
            Self::ItemLimit => "private prepared item budget exceeded",
            Self::ValueLimit => "private prepared field budget exceeded",
            Self::KeyLimit => "private prepared state key too large",
            Self::ScopeLimit => "private prepared isolation scope too large",
            Self::LengthOverflow => "private prepared length overflow",
            Self::Allocation => "private prepared allocation failed",
        })
    }
}
impl std::error::Error for CodecError {}

/// Prepares one normalized policy envelope without installation or submission.
///
/// # Errors
/// Rejects malformed values or complete private snapshot/envelope limits.
pub fn prepare_policy(
    candidate: PolicyCandidate,
    limits: CodecLimits,
) -> Result<PolicyValue, CodecError> {
    policy::prepare(candidate, limits)
}

/// Encodes only supported typed preparation values without submission/effects.
///
/// # Errors
/// Rejects unsupported/malformed structure and immutable resource bounds.
pub fn encode_prepared(
    request: &PreparedRequest,
    limits: CodecLimits,
) -> Result<PreparedBytes, CodecError> {
    if let PreparedOperation::InstallPolicy { value, .. } = &request.operation {
        policy::verify(value, limits)?;
    }
    let mut measure = writer::Writer::measure(limits.admission.decision_bytes());
    encode::write(request, &mut measure, limits)?;
    let mut output = writer::Writer::allocate(measure.len(), limits.admission.decision_bytes())?;
    encode::write(request, &mut output, limits)?;
    let bytes = output.finish()?;
    Ok(PreparedBytes {
        digest: digest(&bytes),
        bytes,
    })
}

/// Decodes exactly one bounded private command; public requests cannot use this.
///
/// # Errors
/// Rejects corruption/unsupported structure and immutable resource bounds.
pub fn decode_prepared(
    encoded: &[u8],
    limits: CodecLimits,
) -> Result<DecodedRequest<'_>, CodecError> {
    scan::preflight(encoded, limits)?;
    decode::read(encoded, limits)
}

fn digest(bytes: &[u8]) -> PreparedDigest {
    PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(bytes).into())
}
```

```rust
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use super::{CheckResult, graph, metadata, package_mut, policy, root};

fn dependency() -> Value {
    json!({
        "name": "sha2", "kind": null, "optional": false, "target": null,
        "source": "registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index",
        "req": "=0.11.0", "features": [], "uses_default_features": false,
    })
}

#[test]
fn private_ports_codec_hash_policy_is_exact_and_cannot_leak() -> CheckResult<()> {
    let original = metadata()?;
    let policy = policy()?;
    let mut approved = original.clone();
    let dependencies = package_mut(&mut approved, "wf-ports")?["dependencies"]
        .as_array_mut()
        .ok_or("missing dependencies")?;
    dependencies.retain(|entry| entry["name"] != "sha2");
    dependencies.push(dependency());
    assert_eq!(
        graph::check(&approved, &policy, &root()?)?,
        Vec::<String>::new()
    );
    for (field, value) in [
        ("req", json!("=0.10.9")),
        ("source", json!("git+https://example.invalid/sha2")),
        ("features", json!(["std"])),
        ("uses_default_features", json!(true)),
    ] {
        let mut changed = approved.clone();
        let hash = package_mut(&mut changed, "wf-ports")?["dependencies"]
            .as_array_mut()
            .ok_or("missing dependencies")?
            .iter_mut()
            .find(|entry| entry["name"] == "sha2")
            .ok_or("missing exact hash")?;
        hash[field] = value;
        assert_ne!(
            graph::check(&changed, &policy, &root()?)?,
            Vec::<String>::new()
        );
    }
    for package in ["wf-types", "wf-domain", "wf-wire"] {
        let mut changed = approved.clone();
        package_mut(&mut changed, package)?["dependencies"]
            .as_array_mut()
            .ok_or("missing dependencies")?
            .push(dependency());
        assert_ne!(
            graph::check(&changed, &policy, &root()?)?,
            Vec::<String>::new()
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn complete_policy_outer_hash_and_dependency_boundaries_remain_closed() -> CheckResult<()> {
    let mut original = metadata()?;
    let rules = policy()?;
    let workspace = root()?;
    assert_eq!(
        graph::check(&original, &rules, &workspace)?,
        Vec::<String>::new()
    );
    let expected = dependency();
    let mut hash_count = 0;
    for entry in package_mut(&mut original, "wf-ports")?["dependencies"]
        .as_array()
        .ok_or("missing dependencies")?
    {
        if entry["name"] == "sha2" {
            for field in [
                "kind",
                "optional",
                "target",
                "source",
                "req",
                "features",
                "uses_default_features",
            ] {
                assert_eq!(entry[field], expected[field]);
            }
            hash_count += 1;
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(hash_count, 1);

    for package in ["wf-types", "wf-domain", "wf-wire"] {
        let mut leaked = original.clone();
        package_mut(&mut leaked, package)?["dependencies"]
            .as_array_mut()
            .ok_or("missing dependencies")?
            .push(dependency());
        assert_eq!(
            graph::check(&leaked, &rules, &workspace)?,
            vec![format!(
                "unclassified external edge {package} -> sha2 (normal, optional=false, target=null)"
            )]
        );
    }

    let mut backwards = original;
    let mut back_edge = dependency();
    back_edge["name"] = json!("wf-ports");
    back_edge["source"] = Value::Null;
    back_edge["req"] = json!("*");
    back_edge["path"] = json!(workspace.join("crates/wf-ports"));
    package_mut(&mut backwards, "wf-domain")?["dependencies"]
        .as_array_mut()
        .ok_or("missing dependencies")?
        .push(back_edge);
    assert_eq!(
        graph::check(&backwards, &rules, &workspace)?,
        vec![String::from(
            "forbidden declared edge wf-domain -> wf-ports (normal, optional=false, target=null)"
        )]
    );
    for module in [
        "policy::complete::outer::caller::core_patch",
        "policy::complete::outer::core_patch_frame",
        "policy::complete::outer::core_patch_frame::scan",
        "policy::complete::outer::core_patch_frame::decode",
    ] {
        assert_eq!(
            super::source_check(
                "wf-domain",
                module,
                "use std::collections::BTreeMap; use wf_types::identity;"
            )?,
            Vec::<String>::new()
        );
        assert!(
            super::source_check("wf-domain", module, "use std::env;")?
                .iter()
                .any(|finding| finding.contains("unclassified standard-library module"))
        );
    }
    for facade in [
        "pub use crate::log::CompleteCorePolicyPatchIntent;",
        "pub use crate::log::VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame;",
        "pub use crate::log::DecodedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame;",
    ] {
        assert!(
            super::source_check("wf-ports", "client", facade)?
                .iter()
                .any(|finding| finding.contains("client port facade"))
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
    assert_eq!(first_outcome.response(), CORE_PATCH_PARENT_MINIMAL);
    assert!(policies.is_empty() && outcomes.is_empty() && marks.is_empty());

    let policies = BTreeMap::from([(
        b"r".to_vec(),
        Ok(core_patch_parent_value(0, limits, &mut charge)?),
    )]);
    let frame = core_patch_parent_frame(7, b"q", 0)?;
    let data = core_patch_parent_source8_data();
    for (active_generation, completed_generation, generation) in [(0, 0, 2_u64), (5, 7, 8)] {
        let active = BTreeMap::from([(b"r".to_vec(), Ok(active_generation))]);
        let done = BTreeMap::from([(b"r".to_vec(), Ok(completed_generation))]);
        let mut expected = decode_core_patch_literal(CORE_PATCH_PARENT_VALUES[3].0)?;
        expected[6..14].copy_from_slice(&generation.to_be_bytes());
        let view = core_patch_parent_view(&scope, control, &outcomes, &policies, &active, &done);
        let plan = core_patch_parent_apply(view, &frame, 0, limits, &mut charge)?;
        assert_core_patch_parent_accepted(&plan, &data, &expected, 1, &frame, (b"q", 0, 0))?;
        assert_core_patch_parent_control(&plan, view, &frame, 0, 0, false)?;
        assert_eq!(active.get(b"r".as_slice()), Some(&Ok(active_generation)));
        assert_eq!(done.get(b"r".as_slice()), Some(&Ok(completed_generation)));
        assert_eq!(
            core_patch_parent_stored(&policies)?.encoded(),
            decode_core_patch_literal(CORE_PATCH_PARENT_VALUES[0].0)?.as_slice()
        );
        assert!(outcomes.is_empty());
    }
    assert_core_patch_parent_presence(limits, &mut charge)?;
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn core_patch_parent_preserves_stored_cas_context_and_high_water_order() -> TestResult {
    let limits = profile(20_000_000)?;
    let mut charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(limits);
    assert_core_patch_parent_current_order(limits, &mut charge)?;
    assert_core_patch_parent_full_max(limits, &mut charge)?;
    let scope = core_patch_parent_scope()?;
    let control = ControlState::initial(core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?);
    let outcomes = BTreeMap::new();
    let policies = BTreeMap::new();
    let frame = core_patch_parent_frame(0, b"q", 0)?;
    for case in 0..7 {
        let active = BTreeMap::from([(
            b"r".to_vec(),
            match case {
                1 => Err(ApplyError::PositionConflict),
                2 | 3 => Ok(MAX_POLICY_GENERATION),
                4 => Ok(MAX_POLICY_GENERATION + 1),
                _ => Ok(2),
            },
        )]);
        let done = BTreeMap::from([(
            b"r".to_vec(),
            match case {
                1 | 2 | 4 => Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed),
                5 => Ok(MAX_POLICY_GENERATION - 1),
                _ => Ok(5),
            },
        )]);
        let mut view =
            core_patch_parent_view(&scope, control, &outcomes, &policies, &active, &done);
        if case == 0 {
            view.history_max_events_limit = Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed);
        }
        let before = charge.g();
        let result = core_patch_parent_apply(view, &frame, 0, limits, &mut charge);
        if case <= 2 || case == 4 {
            let (error, fee) = match case {
                0 => (ApplyError::AllocationFailed, 6_788),
                1 => (ApplyError::PositionConflict, 8_455),
                2 => (ApplyError::AllocationFailed, 8_584),
                _ => (ApplyError::InvalidAuthority, 8_455),
            };
            assert_eq!(
                result.err().ok_or("expected ordered authority refusal")?,
                CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Apply(error)
            );
            assert_eq!((charge.g(), charge.p()), (before + fee, 0));
        } else {
            let plan = result?;
            assert_core_patch_parent_control(&plan, view, &frame, 0, 0, false)?;
            if case == 3 {
                let DispatchDecision::Fresh((None, outcome)) = plan.decision() else {
                    return Err("expected late exhaustion business outcome".into());
                };
                assert_core_patch_parent_outcome(
                    outcome,
                    CORE_PATCH_PARENT_BUSINESS[6].1,
                    RetainedStatus::PolicyRejected(PolicyRejection::new(
                        PolicyError::GenerationExhausted,
                    )?),
                    &frame[83..],
                    (b"q", 0, 0),
                )?;
            } else {
                let mut expected = CORE_PATCH_PARENT_MINIMAL.to_vec();
                expected[6..14].copy_from_slice(
                    &(if case == 5 { MAX_POLICY_GENERATION } else { 6 }).to_be_bytes(),
                );
                assert_core_patch_parent_accepted(
                    &plan,
                    &minimal_data(),
                    &expected,
                    0,
                    &frame,
                    (b"q", 0, 0),
                )?;
            }
        }
        assert!(policies.is_empty() && outcomes.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(active.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(done.len(), 1);
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn core_patch_parent_classifies_business_and_operational_failures() -> TestResult {
    let limits = profile(30_000_000)?;
    let mut charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(limits);
    let scope = core_patch_parent_scope()?;
    let control = ControlState::initial(core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?);
    let outcomes = BTreeMap::new();
    let policies = BTreeMap::new();
    let done = BTreeMap::new();
    for (case, &(error, body)) in CORE_PATCH_PARENT_BUSINESS.iter().enumerate() {
        let frame = core_patch_parent_business_frame(case)?;
        let active = if case == 6 {
            BTreeMap::from([(b"r".to_vec(), Ok(MAX_POLICY_GENERATION))])
        } else {
            BTreeMap::new()
        };
        let view = core_patch_parent_view(&scope, control, &outcomes, &policies, &active, &done);
        let plan = core_patch_parent_apply(view, &frame, 0, limits, &mut charge)?;
        assert_core_patch_parent_control(&plan, view, &frame, 0, 0, false)?;
        let DispatchDecision::Fresh((None, outcome)) = plan.decision() else {
            return Err("expected exact business-only retained body".into());
        };
        assert_core_patch_parent_outcome(
            outcome,
            body,
            RetainedStatus::PolicyRejected(PolicyRejection::new(error)?),
            &frame[83..],
            (b"q", 0, 0),
        )?;
        assert!(policies.is_empty() && outcomes.is_empty() && done.is_empty());
    }
    let minimal = decode_core_patch_literal(FROZEN_CORE_PATCH_FRAMES[0].0)?;
    for length in [262_144, 262_145] {
        let mut intent = minimal[83..].to_vec();
        let mut payload = vec![1, 0];
        payload.extend_from_slice(&u32::try_from(length)?.to_be_bytes());
        payload.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(b'x', length));
        drop(intent.splice(44..45, payload));
        let frame = core_patch_prepare_literal_frame(
            &intent,
            [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"q"],
            core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?,
        )?;
        let mut view = core_patch_parent_view(&scope, control, &outcomes, &policies, &done, &done);
        view.outcome_retention_ms = Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed);
        let expected = if length == 262_144 {
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(PolicySchemaError::SnapshotBytes)
        } else {
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit
        };
        assert_eq!(
            core_patch_parent_apply(view, &frame, 0, limits, &mut charge)
                .err()
                .ok_or("raw/merged caps remain operational before window")?,
            CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Request(expected.into())
        );
    }
    let before = charge.g();
    let frame = core_patch_parent_frame(0, b"q", 0)?;
    let view = core_patch_parent_view(&scope, control, &outcomes, &policies, &done, &done);
    assert_eq!(
        decide_complete_core_policy_patch_frame(
            view,
            &frame,
            core_patch_parent_log(0),
            profile(1)?,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            &mut charge
        )
        .err()
        .ok_or("entry profile refusal")?,
        CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Request(PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch.into())
    );
    assert_eq!(charge.g(), before);
    assert_core_patch_parent_operational(limits, &mut charge)?;
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn core_patch_parent_threads_one_account_through_every_reached_phase() -> TestResult {
    for &(target, retained) in CORE_PATCH_PARENT_PHASES {
        let maximum = target - 1;
        let limits = profile(maximum)?;
        let mut charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(limits);
        let scope = core_patch_parent_scope()?;
        let empty = BTreeMap::new();
        let migrations = BTreeMap::new();
        let outcomes = BTreeMap::new();
        let frame = core_patch_parent_frame(0, b"q", 0)?;
        let view = core_patch_parent_view(
            &scope,
            ControlState::initial(core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?),
            &outcomes,
            &empty,
            &migrations,
            &migrations,
        );
        let result = core_patch_parent_apply(view, &frame, 0, limits, &mut charge);
        assert_eq!(
            result
                .err()
                .ok_or("expected prospective same-account refusal")?,
            CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Request(
                PolicySchemaError::WorkBytes {
                    bytes: target,
                    maximum
                }
                .into()
            )
        );
        assert_eq!(
            (charge.g(), charge.p(), charge.total()),
            (retained, 0, retained)
        );
        assert!(empty.is_empty() && outcomes.is_empty() && migrations.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(view.gate.control.last_entry(), None);
    }
    for (target, attempts, peak) in [
        (11_178, 1, false),
        (22_356, 2, false),
        (13_170, 1, true),
        (24_348, 2, true),
    ] {
        assert_core_patch_parent_account(target, target, attempts, peak)?;
        assert_core_patch_parent_account(target - 1, target, attempts, peak)?;
    }
    assert_core_patch_parent_current_restoration()?;
    Ok(())
}

fn assert_core_patch_parent_current_order(
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> TestResult {
    let scope = core_patch_parent_scope()?;
    let outcomes = BTreeMap::new();
    let migrations = BTreeMap::from([(b"r".to_vec(), Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed))]);
    let frame = core_patch_parent_frame(1, b"q", 0)?;
    let control = ControlState::initial(core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?);
    let mut policies = BTreeMap::from([(b"r".to_vec(), Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed))]);
    let mut view = core_patch_parent_view(
        &scope,
        control,
        &outcomes,
        &policies,
        &migrations,
        &migrations,
    );
    view.history_max_events_limit = Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed);
    view.outcome_retention_ms = Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed);
    assert_eq!(
        core_patch_parent_apply(view, &frame, 0, limits, charge)
            .err()
            .ok_or("stored read must precede stale CAS")?,
        CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Apply(ApplyError::AllocationFailed)
    );
    let mut foreign = CORE_PATCH_PARENT_MINIMAL.to_vec();
    foreign[28] = b"u";
    let value = decode_complete_policy_value_v2(&foreign, limits, charge)?;
    policies.insert(b"r".to_vec(), Ok(value));
    for case in 0..2 {
        if case == 1 {
            let candidate = restore_complete_policy(1, minimal_data(), limits, charge)?;
            let mut malformed = CORE_PATCH_PARENT_MINIMAL.to_vec();
            malformed[0] ^= 1;
            let value = candidate.bind_encoded_snapshot(18..40, malformed, limits, charge)?;
            policies.insert(b"r".to_vec(), Ok(value));
        }
        let mut view = core_patch_parent_view(
            &scope,
            control,
            &outcomes,
            &policies,
            &migrations,
            &migrations,
        );
        view.history_max_events_limit = Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed);
        view.outcome_retention_ms = Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed);
        let result = core_patch_parent_apply(view, &frame, 0, limits, charge);
        let expected = if case == 0 {
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(PolicySchemaError::InvalidAuthority)
        } else {
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::EncodingMismatch
        };
        assert_eq!(
            result
                .err()
                .ok_or("current authority must precede stale CAS")?,
            CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Request(expected.into())
        );
        let current = core_patch_parent_stored(&policies)?;
        let before = charge.g();
        assert_eq!(
            prepare_complete_core_policy_patch(
                Some(current),
                MAX_POLICY_GENERATION,
                core_patch_prepare_command(1)?,
                0,
                limits,
                charge
            )
            .err()
            .ok_or("standalone remains guard first")?,
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(PolicySchemaError::Policy(
                PolicyError::StaleGeneration
            ))
        );
        assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 128);
        assert_eq!(current.generation(), 1);
        assert!(outcomes.is_empty());
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn assert_core_patch_parent_operational(
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> TestResult {
    let scope = core_patch_parent_scope()?;
    let outcomes = BTreeMap::new();
    let empty = BTreeMap::new();
    let migrations = BTreeMap::new();
    let control = ControlState::initial(core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?);
    let default = core_patch_parent_frame(0, b"q", 0)?;
    for case in 0..6 {
        let mut view =
            core_patch_parent_view(&scope, control, &outcomes, &empty, &migrations, &migrations);
        let (frame, admission, expected) = match case {
            0 => {
                view.outcome_retention_ms = Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed);
                (
                    default.clone(),
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Apply(ApplyError::AllocationFailed),
                )
            }
            1 => {
                view.outcome_retention_ms = Ok(0);
                (
                    core_patch_parent_business_frame(5)?,
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Outcome(RequestValueError::InvalidExpiry),
                )
            }
            2 => {
                view.history_max_events_limit = Ok(0);
                (
                    default.clone(),
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Apply(ApplyError::InvalidAuthority),
                )
            }
            3 => (
                default.clone(),
                AdmissionLimits::new(1_048_576, 134, 1_000)?,
                CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Request(
                    CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into(),
                ),
            ),
            4 => {
                view.outcome_retention_ms = Err(ApplyError::PositionConflict);
                (
                    core_patch_parent_business_frame(5)?,
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Apply(ApplyError::PositionConflict),
                )
            }
            _ => {
                view.outcome_retention_ms = Ok(u64::MAX);
                let stale = core_patch_parent_business_frame(5)?;
                let frame = core_patch_prepare_literal_frame(
                    &stale[83..],
                    [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"q"],
                    core_patch_parent_stamp(1)?,
                )?;
                (
                    frame,
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Outcome(RequestValueError::InvalidExpiry),
                )
            }
        };
        let before = charge.g();
        assert_eq!(
            decide_complete_core_policy_patch_frame(
                view,
                &frame,
                core_patch_parent_log(0),
                limits,
                admission,
                charge
            )
            .err()
            .ok_or("operational failure returns no parent")?,
            expected
        );
        if case == 0 {
            assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 10_626);
        }
        if case == 2 {
            assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 6_788);
        }
        if case == 3 {
            assert_eq!(charge.g(), before);
        }
        assert!(outcomes.is_empty() && empty.is_empty() && migrations.is_empty());
    }
    assert_core_patch_parent_limits(limits, charge)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn assert_core_patch_parent_replay_branch(
    view: CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyView<'_>,
    incoming: &[u8],
    original: (&[u8], &[u8], RetainedStatus),
    scenario: (usize, u64, u64),
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> TestResult {
    let (branch, time, verifier) = scenario;
    let index = u64::from(branch != 3);
    let before = charge.g();
    let plan = core_patch_parent_apply(view, incoming, index, limits, charge)?;
    assert_core_patch_parent_control(&plan, view, incoming, index, time, branch == 3)?;
    let retained = view
        .gate
        .outcomes
        .get(&RequestId::new(b"q".to_vec())?)
        .ok_or("held original parent-derived outcome")?;
    assert_core_patch_parent_outcome(
        retained,
        original.1,
        original.2,
        &original.0[83..],
        (b"q", 10, 0),
    )?;
    let fee = match branch {
        1 => 1_107,
        3 => 390,
        _ => 1_235,
    };
    assert_eq!((charge.g(), charge.p()), (before + verifier + fee, 0));
    assert_eq!(view.gate.outcomes.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(
        view.policies
            .get(b"r".as_slice())
            .ok_or("poison current")?
            .as_ref()
            .err(),
        Some(&ApplyError::AllocationFailed)
    );
    assert_eq!(
        view.active_migrations.get(b"r".as_slice()),
        Some(&Err(ApplyError::PositionConflict))
    );
    assert_eq!(
        view.completed_migrations.get(b"r".as_slice()),
        Some(&Err(ApplyError::PositionConflict))
    );
    assert_eq!(
        view.history_max_events_limit,
        Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed)
    );
    assert_eq!(view.outcome_retention_ms, Err(ApplyError::PositionConflict));
    match plan.decision() {
        DispatchDecision::Replay(replayed) if branch == 0 => {
            assert_core_patch_parent_outcome(
                replayed,
                original.1,
                original.2,
                &original.0[83..],
                (b"q", 10, 0),
            )?;
            assert!(std::ptr::eq(*replayed, retained));
            assert_eq!(replayed.response().as_ptr(), retained.response().as_ptr());
        }
        DispatchDecision::IntentConflict if branch == 1 => {}
        DispatchDecision::Expired if branch == 2 => {}
        DispatchDecision::LogReplay if branch == 3 => {}
        _ => return Err("nonFresh branch must not reach reconstruction".into()),
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
) -> TestResult<Vec<u8>> {
    let original = decode_core_patch_literal(FROZEN_CORE_PATCH_FRAMES[case].0)?;
    core_patch_prepare_literal_frame(
        &original[83..],
        [b"t", b"g", b"r", request],
        core_patch_parent_stamp(time)?,
    )
}

pub(super) fn core_patch_parent_value(
    case: usize,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> TestResult<CompletePolicyValue> {
    let expected = decode_core_patch_literal(CORE_PATCH_PARENT_VALUES[case].0)?;
    let hash = decode_core_patch_literal(CORE_PATCH_PARENT_VALUES[case].1)?;
    assert_eq!(
        <[u8; 32]>::from(Sha256::digest(&expected)).as_slice(),
        hash.as_slice()
    );
    let value = decode_complete_policy_value_v2(&expected, limits, charge)?;
    let generation = match case {
        0 => 1,
        1 | 3 => 2,
        2 => MAX_POLICY_GENERATION,
        _ => return Err("unknown VALUE literal".into()),
    };
    let data = if case == 3 {
        core_patch_parent_source8_data()
    } else {
        present_data()
    };
    assert_eq!(value.generation(), generation);
    assert!(value.data() == &data);
    assert_eq!(value.encoded(), expected.as_slice());
    Ok(value)
}

pub(super) fn core_patch_parent_rows(
    generation: u64,
    rows: &BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>>,
) -> TestResult<Vec<u8>> {
    let anchor = decode_core_patch_literal(CORE_PATCH_PARENT_VALUES[0].0)?;
    let mut expected = anchor[..92].to_vec();
    expected[6..14].copy_from_slice(&generation.to_be_bytes());
    expected.extend_from_slice(&u32::try_from(rows.len())?.to_be_bytes());
    for row in rows.values() {
        expected.extend_from_slice(row);
    }
    expected.extend_from_slice(&anchor[130..]);
    let snapshot_len = u32::try_from(expected.len() - 18)?;
    expected[14..18].copy_from_slice(&snapshot_len.to_be_bytes());
    Ok(expected)
}

pub(super) fn assert_core_patch_parent_control(
    plan: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestPlan<'_>,
    view: CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyView<'_>,
    frame: &[u8],
    index: u64,
    time: u64,
    replay: bool,
) -> TestResult {
    let stamp = core_patch_parent_stamp(time)?;
    let identity = EntryIdentity::new(
        core_patch_parent_log(index),
        PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(frame).into()),
    );
    let expected = if replay {
        view.gate.control
    } else {
        let time = CommittedTime::new(
            view.gate.control.time().hlc().max(stamp.hlc()),
            view.gate.control.time().wall().max(stamp.wall()).get(),
        )?;
        ControlState::restored(time, identity, EntryStamp::Stamped(stamp))?
    };
    assert_eq!(plan.expected_revision(), view.revision);
    assert_eq!(plan.base_control(), view.gate.control);
    assert_eq!(plan.control().next(), expected);
    assert_eq!(plan.control().is_log_replay(), replay);
    assert_eq!(
        plan.control().execution_time(),
        expected.time().hlc().physical()
    );
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn assert_core_patch_parent_outcome(
    outcome: &RetainedOutcome,
    expected: &[u8],
    status: RetainedStatus,
    intent: &[u8],
    metadata: (&[u8], u64, u64),
) -> TestResult {
    let (request, time, index) = metadata;
    assert_eq!(outcome.scope().tenant().as_bytes(), b"t");
    assert_eq!(outcome.scope().group().as_bytes(), b"g");
    assert_eq!(outcome.scope().recovery().as_bytes(), b"r");
    assert_eq!(outcome.request().as_bytes(), request);
    assert_eq!(outcome.intent().version(), 2);
    assert_eq!(
        outcome.intent().digest(),
        &<[u8; 32]>::from(Sha256::digest(intent))
    );
    assert_eq!(outcome.response_version(), 1);
    assert_eq!(outcome.status(), status);
    assert_eq!(outcome.response(), expected);
    assert_eq!(outcome.original_position(), core_patch_parent_log(index));
    assert_eq!(outcome.original_time().get(), time);
    assert_eq!(outcome.expires_at().get(), time + 100);
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn assert_core_patch_parent_accepted(
    plan: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestPlan<'_>,
    data: &CompletePolicyData,
    expected: &[u8],
    stored: u64,
    frame: &[u8],
    metadata: (&[u8], u64, u64),
) -> TestResult {
    let DispatchDecision::Fresh((Some((observed, value)), outcome)) = plan.decision() else {
        return Err("expected complete accepted Fresh owners".into());
    };
    assert_eq!(*observed, stored);
    assert_eq!(
        value.generation(),
        u64::from_be_bytes(expected[6..14].try_into()?)
    );
    assert!(value.data() == data);
    assert_eq!(value.encoded(), expected);
    assert_core_patch_parent_outcome(
        outcome,
        expected,
        RetainedStatus::Accepted,
        &frame[82 + metadata.0.len()..],
        metadata,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn core_patch_parent_business_frame(case: usize) -> TestResult<Vec<u8>> {
    if let Some(original) = match case {
        0 => Some(12),
        2 => Some(14),
        3 => Some(5),
        4 => Some(2),
        9 => Some(15),
        14 => Some(13),
        _ => None,
    } {
        return core_patch_parent_frame(original, b"q", 0);
    }
    let minimal = decode_core_patch_literal(FROZEN_CORE_PATCH_FRAMES[0].0)?;
    let mut intent = minimal[83..].to_vec();
    let payload = match case {
        1 => (45, "010000000000000000"),
        7 => (47, "0101000000000000000000"),
        8 => (47, "010001000f4241"),
        10 => (46, "010103e90000"),
        11 => (46, "0100010001000000009a7ec801000000"),
        12 => (46, "010001000001000000009a7ec8010000"),
        13 => (46, "010001000000016500"),
        15 => (46, "010000010000000772756e6e696e67"),
        _ => (0, ""),
    };
    if payload.0 != 0 {
        drop(intent.splice(payload.0..=payload.0, decode_core_patch_literal(payload.1)?));
    } else if case == 5 {
        let guarded = decode_core_patch_literal(FROZEN_CORE_PATCH_FRAMES[1].0)?;
        intent = guarded[83..].to_vec();
        intent[39..47].copy_from_slice(&1_u64.to_be_bytes());
    } else if case == 16 || case == 17 {
        intent[48..52].copy_from_slice(&1_u32.to_be_bytes());
        let name: &[u8] = if case == 16 { b"" } else { b"running" };
        intent.extend_from_slice(&u32::try_from(name.len())?.to_be_bytes());
        intent.extend_from_slice(name);
        intent.extend_from_slice(&[1, 0, 0, 0]);
    } else if case != 6 {
        return Err("unknown business literal recipe".into());
    }
    core_patch_prepare_literal_frame(
        &intent,
        [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"q"],
        core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?,
    )
}

pub(super) fn assert_core_patch_parent_presence(
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> TestResult {
    let scope = core_patch_parent_scope()?;
    let control = ControlState::initial(core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?);
    let outcomes = BTreeMap::new();
    let migrations = BTreeMap::new();
    let anchor = decode_core_patch_literal(CORE_PATCH_PARENT_VALUES[0].0)?;
    let policies = BTreeMap::from([(
        b"r".to_vec(),
        Ok(core_patch_parent_value(0, limits, charge)?),
    )]);
    let minimal = decode_core_patch_literal(FROZEN_CORE_PATCH_FRAMES[0].0)?;
    for case in 0..11 {
        let mut intent = minimal[83..].to_vec();
        let mut data = present_data();
        let mut rows = BTreeMap::from([(b"s".to_vec(), anchor[96..130].to_vec())]);
        intent = core_patch_parent_presence_intent(case, intent)?;
        if case == 5 {
            rows.remove(b"s".as_slice());
            data.states.remove(b"s".as_slice());
        } else if case == 7 || case == 9 {
            let row = rows.get_mut(b"s".as_slice()).ok_or("missing fixed s row")?;
            let state = data
                .states
                .get_mut(b"s".as_slice())
                .ok_or("missing independent s data")?;
            let range = if case == 7 {
                state.retry = None;
                7..11
            } else {
                state.retention = None;
                11..26
            };
            drop(row.splice(range, [0]));
        }
        let mut expected = core_patch_parent_rows(2, &rows)?;
        if case == 1 {
            data.retry = None;
            drop(expected.splice(48..77, [0]));
        }
        if case == 3 {
            data.retention = None;
            drop(expected.splice(77..92, [0]));
        }
        let length = u32::try_from(expected.len() - 18)?;
        expected[14..18].copy_from_slice(&length.to_be_bytes());
        let frame = core_patch_prepare_literal_frame(
            &intent,
            [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"q"],
            core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?,
        )?;
        let view = core_patch_parent_view(
            &scope,
            control,
            &outcomes,
            &policies,
            &migrations,
            &migrations,
        );
        let plan = core_patch_parent_apply(view, &frame, 0, limits, charge)?;
        assert_core_patch_parent_accepted(&plan, &data, &expected, 1, &frame, (b"q", 0, 0))?;
        assert_core_patch_parent_control(&plan, view, &frame, 0, 0, false)?;
        assert_eq!(
            core_patch_parent_stored(&policies)?.encoded(),
            anchor.as_slice()
        );
        assert!(outcomes.is_empty() && migrations.is_empty());
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn core_patch_parent_source8_data() -> CompletePolicyData {
    let mut data = present_data();
    data.states.insert(
        b"queued".to_vec(),
        CompleteStatePolicyData {
            mode: None,
            retry: Some(RetryOverride {
                exhausted_to: Some(b"dead".to_vec()),
                ..RetryOverride::default()
            }),
            retention: None,
            governance: None,
        },
    );
    data.states.insert(
        b"review".to_vec(),
        CompleteStatePolicyData {
            mode: Some(StateMode::Fifo),
            retry: None,
            retention: None,
            governance: None,
        },
    );
    data
}

pub(super) fn assert_core_patch_parent_current_restoration() -> TestResult {
    let limits = profile(11_793)?;
    let mut charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(limits);
    let current = decode_complete_policy_value_v2(CORE_PATCH_PARENT_MINIMAL, limits, &mut charge)?;
    assert_eq!((charge.g(), charge.p()), (2_153, 0));
    let scope = core_patch_parent_scope()?;
    let outcomes = BTreeMap::new();
    let policies = BTreeMap::from([(b"r".to_vec(), Ok(current))]);
    let poison = BTreeMap::from([(b"r".to_vec(), Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed))]);
    let frame = core_patch_parent_frame(0, b"q", 0)?;
    let mut view = core_patch_parent_view(
        &scope,
        ControlState::initial(core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?),
        &outcomes,
        &policies,
        &poison,
        &poison,
    );
    view.history_max_events_limit = Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed);
    view.outcome_retention_ms = Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed);
    assert_eq!(
        core_patch_parent_apply(view, &frame, 0, limits, &mut charge)
            .err()
            .ok_or("expected paid current restoration refusal")?,
        CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Request(
            PolicySchemaError::WorkBytes {
                bytes: 11_794,
                maximum: 11_793
            }
            .into()
        )
    );
    assert_eq!(
        (charge.g(), charge.p(), charge.total()),
        (11_666, 0, 11_666)
    );
    assert_eq!(
        core_patch_parent_stored(&policies)?.encoded(),
        CORE_PATCH_PARENT_MINIMAL
    );
    assert!(outcomes.is_empty());

    Ok(())
}

fn core_patch_parent_presence_intent(case: usize, mut intent: Vec<u8>) -> TestResult<Vec<u8>> {
    let top = match case {
        1 => Some((46, &[2][..])),
        2 => Some((46, &[1, 0, 0, 0][..])),
        3 => Some((47, &[2][..])),
        4 => Some((47, &[1, 0, 0][..])),
        _ => None,
    };
    if let Some((offset, payload)) = top {
        drop(intent.splice(offset..=offset, payload.iter().copied()));
    } else if case >= 5 {
        intent[48..52].copy_from_slice(&1_u32.to_be_bytes());
        intent.extend_from_slice(b"\0\0\0\x01s");
        let payload = match case {
            5 => &[0][..],
            6 => &[1, 0, 0, 0][..],
            7 => &[1, 0, 2, 0][..],
            8 => &[1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0][..],
            9 => &[1, 0, 0, 2][..],
            10 => &[1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0][..],
            _ => return Err("unknown state presence".into()),
        };
        intent.extend_from_slice(payload);
    }

    Ok(intent)
}

pub(super) fn core_patch_parent_apply<'view>(
    view: CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyView<'view>,
    frame: &[u8],
    index: u64,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestPlan<'view>, CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError> {
    decide_complete_core_policy_patch_frame(
        view,
        frame,
        core_patch_parent_log(index),
        limits,
        AdmissionLimits::default(),
        charge,
    )
}

pub(super) fn core_patch_parent_writer_step(
    view: CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyView<'_>,
    frame: &[u8],
    expected: (&CompletePolicyData, &[u8], u64),
    metadata: (&[u8], u64),
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> TestResult<(ControlState, CompleteCorePolicyPatchFresh)> {
    let plan = core_patch_parent_apply(view, frame, metadata.1, limits, charge)?;
    assert_core_patch_parent_accepted(
        &plan,
        expected.0,
        expected.1,
        expected.2,
        frame,
        (metadata.0, metadata.1, metadata.1),
    )?;
    assert_core_patch_parent_control(&plan, view, frame, metadata.1, metadata.1, false)?;
    let (revision, base, control, decision) = plan.into_parts();
    assert_eq!((revision, base), (view.revision, view.gate.control));
    let DispatchDecision::Fresh(fresh) = decision else {
        return Err("writer expected complete Fresh bundle".into());
    };
    Ok((control.next(), fresh))
}

pub(super) fn core_patch_parent_stored(

    Ok(policies
        .get(b"r".as_slice())
        .ok_or("held mathematical current")?
        .as_ref()
        .map_err(|error| *error)?)
}

    let scope = core_patch_parent_scope()?;

        ControlState::initial(core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?),

        &policies,

    assert_core_patch_parent_control(&plan, view, &frame, 0, 0, false)?;
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
        (setup, scratch, setup + scratch)

        &outcomes,
        &policies,
        &migrations,
        &migrations,
    );

                0,
                &frame,
                (b"q", 0, 0),

    assert_eq!(installed.is_some(), !rejected);
    assert_core_patch_parent_outcome(&original, expected, status, &frame[83..], (b"q", 10, 0))?;
    let outcomes = BTreeMap::from([(RequestId::new(b"q".to_vec())?, original)]);
    let poison_policies = BTreeMap::from([(b"r".to_vec(), Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed))]);
    let poison_migrations = BTreeMap::from([(b"r".to_vec(), Err(ApplyError::PositionConflict))]);
    let mut view = core_patch_parent_view(
        &scope,
        proposed.next(),
        &outcomes,
        &poison_policies,
        &poison_migrations,
        &poison_migrations,
    );
    view.history_max_events_limit = Err(ApplyError::AllocationFailed);
    view.outcome_retention_ms = Err(ApplyError::PositionConflict);
    for branch in 0..4 {
        let incoming_case = if branch == 1 {
            if rejected { 0 } else { 3 }
        } else {
            case
        };
        let time = match branch {
            2 => 110,
            3 => 10,
            _ => 11,
        };
        let incoming = core_patch_parent_frame(incoming_case, b"q", time)?;
        let verifier = FROZEN_CORE_PATCH_FRAMES[incoming_case].3;
        assert_core_patch_parent_replay_branch(
            view,
            &incoming,
            (&frame, expected, status),
            (branch, time, verifier),

    }
    assert_eq!(
        installed.as_ref().map(|(_, value)| value.generation()),
        (!rejected).then_some(1)
    );
    if let Some((stored, value)) = &installed {
        assert_eq!(*stored, 0);
        assert!(value.data() == &minimal_data());
        assert_eq!(value.encoded(), expected);
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn assert_core_patch_parent_limits(
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> TestResult {
    let scope = core_patch_parent_scope()?;
    let control = ControlState::initial(core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?);
    let outcomes = BTreeMap::new();
    let empty = BTreeMap::new();
    let migrations = BTreeMap::new();
    let default = core_patch_parent_frame(0, b"q", 0)?;
    let policies = BTreeMap::from([(
        b"r".to_vec(),
        Ok(core_patch_parent_value(0, limits, charge)?),
    )]);
    let view = core_patch_parent_view(
        &scope,
        control,
        &outcomes,
        &policies,
        &migrations,
        &migrations,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        decide_complete_core_policy_patch_frame(
            view,
            &default,
            core_patch_parent_log(0),
            limits,
            AdmissionLimits::new(1_048_576, 767, 1_000)?,
            charge
        )
        .err()
        .ok_or("whole R=768 must refuse atomically")?,
        CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Request(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into())
    );
    let reduced = PolicySchemaLimits::new(PolicyLimits::new(1)?, 20_000_000)?;
    let mut reduced_charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(reduced);
    let frame = core_patch_parent_frame(7, b"q", 0)?;
    let mut view =
        core_patch_parent_view(&scope, control, &outcomes, &empty, &migrations, &migrations);
    view.outcome_retention_ms = Err(ApplyError::PositionConflict);
    assert_eq!(
        decide_complete_core_policy_patch_frame(
            view,
            &frame,
            core_patch_parent_log(0),
            reduced,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            &mut reduced_charge
        )
        .err()
        .ok_or("new state budget stays operational")?,
        CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Request(
            PolicySchemaError::Policy(PolicyError::StateBudget).into()
        )
    );
    let policies = BTreeMap::from([(
        b"r".to_vec(),
        Ok(core_patch_parent_value(3, limits, charge)?),
    )]);
    let frame = core_patch_parent_frame(1, b"q", 0)?;
    let view = core_patch_parent_view(
        &scope,
        control,
        &outcomes,
        &policies,
        &migrations,
        &migrations,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        decide_complete_core_policy_patch_frame(
            view,
            &frame,
            core_patch_parent_log(0),
            reduced,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            &mut reduced_charge
        )
        .err()
        .ok_or("present selected-profile authority precedes stale CAS")?,
        CompleteCorePolicyPatchApplyError::Request(PolicySchemaError::InvalidAuthority.into())
    );
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn assert_core_patch_parent_writers(
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> TestResult {
    let scope = core_patch_parent_scope()?;
    let mut outcomes = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut policies = BTreeMap::from([(
        b"r".to_vec(),
        Ok(core_patch_parent_value(0, limits, charge)?),
    )]);
    let migrations = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut control = ControlState::initial(core_patch_parent_stamp(0)?);
    let mut revision = 7;
    let anchor = decode_core_patch_literal(CORE_PATCH_PARENT_VALUES[0].0)?;
    let mut rows = BTreeMap::from([(b"s".to_vec(), anchor[96..130].to_vec())]);
    let mut data = present_data();
    let source = decode_core_patch_literal(FROZEN_CORE_PATCH_FRAMES[7].0)?;
    let minimal = decode_core_patch_literal(FROZEN_CORE_PATCH_FRAMES[0].0)?;
    let mut additions = core_patch_parent_source8_data().states;
    let mut first_frame = Vec::new();
    let mut first_response = Vec::new();
    for step in 0..14 {
        let intent = core_patch_parent_writer_intent(
            step,
            &source,
            &minimal,
            &mut rows,
            &mut data,
            &mut additions,
        )?;
        let request = [b'0' + u8::try_from(step)?];
        let frame = core_patch_prepare_literal_frame(
            &intent,
            [b"t", b"g", b"r", &request],
            core_patch_parent_stamp(step)?,
        )?;
        let expected = core_patch_parent_rows(step + 2, &rows)?;
        let mut view = core_patch_parent_view(
            &scope,
            control,
            &outcomes,
            &policies,
            &migrations,
            &migrations,
        );
        view.revision = revision;
        let (next, fresh) = core_patch_parent_writer_step(
            view,
            &frame,
            (&data, &expected, step + 1),
            (&request, step),
            limits,
            charge,
        )?;
        if step == 0 {
            first_frame = frame;
            first_response = expected;
        }
        let (installed, outcome) = fresh;
        let (_, value) = installed.ok_or("writer accepted policy owner")?;
        policies.insert(b"r".to_vec(), Ok(value));
        outcomes.insert(RequestId::new(request.to_vec())?, outcome);
        control = next;
        revision += 1;
        assert_eq!(outcomes.len(), usize::try_from(step + 1)?);
        let held = outcomes
            .get(&RequestId::new(b"0".to_vec())?)
            .ok_or("first held original")?;
        assert_core_patch_parent_outcome(
            held,
            &first_response,
            RetainedStatus::Accepted,
            &first_frame[83..],
            (b"0", 0, 0),
        )?;
    }
    let expected = core_patch_parent_rows(15, &rows)?;
    assert_core_patch_parent_writer_duplicates(
        &scope,
        control,
        revision,
        (&mut outcomes, &policies, &migrations),
        (&first_frame, &first_response, &data, &expected),
        limits,
        charge,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

fn assert_core_patch_parent_writer_duplicates(
    scope: &RequestScope,
    control: ControlState,
    revision: u64,
    authority: (
        &mut BTreeMap<RequestId, RetainedOutcome>,
        &BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Result<CompletePolicyValue, ApplyError>>,
        &BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Result<u64, ApplyError>>,
    ),
    expected: (&[u8], &[u8], &CompletePolicyData, &[u8]),
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> TestResult {
    let (outcomes, policies, migrations) = authority;
    let mut view =
        core_patch_parent_view(scope, control, outcomes, policies, migrations, migrations);
    view.revision = revision;
    let rejected = core_patch_parent_business_frame(5)?;
    let stale = core_patch_prepare_literal_frame(
        &rejected[83..],
        [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"z"],
        core_patch_parent_stamp(20)?,
    )?;
    let plan = core_patch_parent_apply(view, &stale, 14, limits, charge)?;
    assert_core_patch_parent_control(&plan, view, &stale, 14, 20, false)?;
    let DispatchDecision::Fresh((None, outcome)) = plan.decision() else {
        return Err("writer stale CAS rejection".into());
    };
    assert_core_patch_parent_outcome(
        outcome,
        CORE_PATCH_PARENT_BUSINESS[5].1,
        RetainedStatus::PolicyRejected(PolicyRejection::new(PolicyError::StaleGeneration)?),
        &stale[83..],
        (b"z", 20, 14),
    )?;
    let (_, _, next, decision) = plan.into_parts();
    let DispatchDecision::Fresh((None, stale_outcome)) = decision else {
        return Err("whole stale bundle".into());
    };
    outcomes.insert(RequestId::new(b"z".to_vec())?, stale_outcome);
    let incoming = core_patch_prepare_literal_frame(
        &expected.0[83..],
        [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"0"],
        core_patch_parent_stamp(21)?,
    )?;
    let mut replay_view = core_patch_parent_view(
        scope,
        next.next(),
        outcomes,
        policies,
        migrations,
        migrations,
    );
    replay_view.revision = revision + 1;
    let replay = core_patch_parent_apply(replay_view, &incoming, 15, limits, charge)?;
    assert_core_patch_parent_control(&replay, replay_view, &incoming, 15, 21, false)?;
    let original = outcomes
        .get(&RequestId::new(b"0".to_vec())?)
        .ok_or("first writer retained owner")?;
    assert_core_patch_parent_outcome(
        original,
        expected.1,
        RetainedStatus::Accepted,
        &expected.0[83..],
        (b"0", 0, 0),
    )?;
    let current = core_patch_parent_stored(policies)?;
    assert_eq!(current.generation(), 15);
    assert!(current.data() == expected.2);
    assert_eq!(current.encoded(), expected.3);
    assert_eq!(outcomes.len(), 15);
    let DispatchDecision::Replay(replayed) = replay.decision() else {
        return Err("first writer replay".into());
    };
    assert_core_patch_parent_outcome(
        replayed,
        expected.1,
        RetainedStatus::Accepted,
        &expected.0[83..],
        (b"0", 0, 0),
    )?;
    assert!(std::ptr::eq(*replayed, original));
    assert_eq!(replayed.response().as_ptr(), original.response().as_ptr());
    Ok(())
}

fn core_patch_parent_writer_intent(
    step: u64,
    source: &[u8],
    minimal: &[u8],
    rows: &mut BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>>,
    data: &mut CompletePolicyData,
    additions: &mut BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, CompleteStatePolicyData>,
) -> TestResult<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut intent = if step < 2 {
        source[83..135].to_vec()
    } else {
        minimal[83..135].to_vec()
    };
    intent[48..52].copy_from_slice(&1_u32.to_be_bytes());
    let name = match step {
        0 => b"queued".to_vec(),
        1 => b"review".to_vec(),
        _ => vec![b'a' + u8::try_from(step - 2)?],
    };
    if step < 2 {
        let (range, literal) = if step == 0 {
            (
                135..160,
                "00000006717565756564000100000100000004646561640000",
            )
        } else {
            (160..175, "000000067265766965770101000000")
        };
        intent.extend_from_slice(&source[range]);
        rows.insert(name.clone(), decode_core_patch_literal(literal)?);
        data.states.insert(
            name.clone(),
            additions
                .remove(name.as_slice())
                .ok_or("fixed independent SOURCE8 state")?,
        );
    } else {
        intent.extend_from_slice(b"\0\0\0\x01");
        intent.extend_from_slice(&name);
        intent.extend_from_slice(&[1, 0, 0, 0]);
        let mut row = b"\0\0\0\x01".to_vec();
        row.extend_from_slice(&name);
        row.extend_from_slice(&[0, 0, 0, 0]);
        rows.insert(name.clone(), row);
        data.states.insert(
            name,
            CompleteStatePolicyData {
                mode: None,
                retry: None,
                retention: None,
                governance: None,
            },
        );
    }

    Ok(intent)
}
```

```rust
) -> TestResult<CompletePolicyValue> {

    assert_eq!(
        <[u8; 32]>::from(Sha256::digest(&expected)).as_slice(),
        hash.as_slice()

    let value = decode_complete_policy_value_v2(&expected, limits, charge)?;
    let generation = match case {
        0 => 1,
        1 | 3 => 2,
        2 => MAX_POLICY_GENERATION,
        _ => return Err("unknown VALUE literal".into()),

    let data = if case == 3 {

    assert!(value.data() == &data);
    assert_eq!(value.encoded(), expected.as_slice());
```
