Decode order is positive profile, actual cap, magic/version and complete framing/EOF, namespace/semantic checks, then owned fields. All new variable Vec reserves are fallible after measurement/admission; existing typed identity/LeaseToken Vec-to-Box conversions retain their current allocation behavior, so no blanket recoverable-OOM claim is made.

StoredWorkflowRecord has public typed tenant:TenantId,partition:PartitionId,record:WorkflowRecord,ordering:OrderingMetadata fields; encode/decode validate ordering priority0..2. GroupApplyChanges keeps private scope/expected/plan and getters scope(),expected(),plan(),business()->Option<&IndexedBatchPlan<'view>>,outcome()->Option<&RetainedOutcome>,control()->Option<ControlState>. business is only Fresh Accepted, outcome only Fresh, control absent only for LogReplay. new rederives plan_control(expected,next exact identity,next exact stamp), requires full ControlPlan equality and matching log-replay classification, checks Fresh/Replay namespace and Fresh operation/status/body correspondence. ## M2-PHYSICAL-FORMATS1 PROPOSAL1

I actually read HistoryEntry/RetryHistory, RetryPolicy/validate_retry, DueOrder/LaneKey/LaneOrder, plan::build_plan and the existing FWSC/FWSR/FWSO helpers. Exact proposed NEW production inventory, four paths:
1. crates/wf-storage/src/state/key.rs: public key facade, measured escape/navigation helpers and the ONE public private-field DecodedOrderedKey owner.
2. crates/wf-storage/src/state/key/point.rs: group-global control and tenant-scoped record/outcome point-key encoders.
3. crates/wf-storage/src/state/key/ordered.rs: due/FIFO/history prefix and full-key encoders plus three closed decoders.
4. crates/wf-storage/src/state/value/history.rs: full versioned HistoryEntry/RetryHistory encode/decode with borrowed validation before field ownership.

No new private helper struct/enum/trait, namespace model, profile, dependency or generic KV API. Ordinary functions share responsibility within these files. Reuse RequestScope, StateValueError, DueOrder, LaneKey, LaneOrder, HistoryEntry and RetryHistory. DecodedOrderedKey has exactly private family:u8, rank:u8, number:u128, bytes:Vec<u8>, ranges:[(usize,usize);4]. It is not Clone, stores no reference into itself/input, and owns only one measured decoded component buffer. Its five immutable methods are due()->Option<DueOrder<'_>>, lane()->Option<LaneKey<'_>>, member()->Option<(i8,u128,&[u8])>, history_position()->Option<(u64,&str)>, logical_bytes()->usize, and no public constructor or provenance/authority flag. Due owns [id,partition,state,type]; FIFO owns [type,state,partition,id] even when the expected lane is borrowed; history owns only original event ID after checking borrowed expected partition/id. Unused coordinates are zero. number holds due/history u64 widened losslessly or full FIFO u128; rank holds inverse priority or score tag. Getters borrow &owner; no encoded continuation copy is retained. The logical base128 covers this model only as the existing deterministic tariff, not a native allocation/layout/RSS claim.

Exact public free APIs, all Result<_,StateValueError>; maximum_bytes and maximum_decoded_bytes are explicit positive usize:
- encode_control_key(group:&GroupId,recovery:&RecoveryId,maximum_bytes)->Vec<u8>.
- encode_record_key(scope:&RequestScope,partition:&PartitionId,id:&RecordId,maximum_bytes)->Vec<u8>.
- encode_outcome_key(scope:&RequestScope,request:&RequestId,maximum_bytes)->Vec<u8>.
- encode_due_prefix(scope:&RequestScope,maximum_bytes)->Vec<u8>.
- encode_due_key(scope:&RequestScope,key:DueOrder<'_>,maximum_bytes)->Vec<u8>.
- encode_fifo_prefix(scope:&RequestScope,lane:LaneKey<'_>,maximum_bytes)->Vec<u8>.
- encode_fifo_key(scope:&RequestScope,lane:LaneKey<'_>,member:LaneOrder<'_>,maximum_bytes)->Vec<u8>.
- encode_history_prefix(scope:&RequestScope,partition:&PartitionId,id:&RecordId,maximum_bytes)->Vec<u8>.
- encode_history_key(scope:&RequestScope,partition:&PartitionId,id:&RecordId,event:&HistoryEntry,maximum_bytes)->Vec<u8>.
- decode_due_key(bytes:&[u8],scope:&RequestScope,maximum_bytes,maximum_decoded_bytes)->DecodedOrderedKey.
- decode_fifo_key(bytes:&[u8],scope:&RequestScope,lane:LaneKey<'_>,maximum_bytes,maximum_decoded_bytes)->DecodedOrderedKey.
- decode_history_key(bytes:&[u8],scope:&RequestScope,partition:&PartitionId,id:&RecordId,maximum_bytes,maximum_decoded_bytes)->DecodedOrderedKey.
- encode_history(scope:&RequestScope,partition:&PartitionId,id:&RecordId,event:&HistoryEntry,maximum_bytes)->Vec<u8>.
- decode_history(bytes:&[u8],scope:&RequestScope,partition:&PartitionId,id:&RecordId,maximum_bytes)->HistoryEntry.

The first twelve are under state::key; the last two under existing state::value. Point lookup derives exact expected bytes and therefore needs no additional point-decoder model/API. Prefix APIs return only a canonical lower prefix; a later backend still must implement truthful bounded prefix termination and range/head authority. Due uses the whole tenant-scope index prefix, preserving the complete DueOrder rather than silently putting type ahead of its real tie-break. Filtering costs/completeness remain the later adapter's responsibility.

Required EXISTING seams are narrow: claim/index.rs makes current LaneOrder::id public with docs/body unchanged and adds sequence(self)->u128 reading its existing scalar; policy.rs makes existing allocation-free validate_retry public with docs/body unchanged; value/record.rs extracts its existing inline event-tag selection into event_tag(kind)->Result<u8,StateValueError> and exposes that plus existing event(tag) only to sibling value children. The single existing EVENTS table/tags stay unchanged. History reuses those functions, not a second13-event table. Existing value.rs adds its private history child/reexports and StateValueError::Limit docs distinguish measured wire/decoded logical limits. Root alone owns existing state.rs registration, shared checker/facades/ADR/status/ledger edits. No other source seam is proposed.

Literal physical grammar: FWPK + u16BE version1 + family:u8 (0 control,1 record,2 outcome,3 due,4 FIFO,5 history). Every opaque component uses E(x): nonzero byte unchanged, NUL becomes00FF, and the component terminates0000. No other00 follower is valid. This is prefix-free and preserves exact raw byte lexical order, including empty/prefix/NUL/FF; no UTF8 normalization or delimiter assumption. Exact E length is len+zero_count+2, checked before output reservation, at most2len+2.
- Control suffix: E(group),E(recovery). No tenant or per-tenant checkpoint.
- Record suffix: E(group),E(recovery),E(tenant),E(partition),E(id). Type/state never create another record identity.
- Outcome suffix: E(group),E(recovery),E(tenant),E(request).
- Due prefix: E(group),E(recovery),E(tenant). Suffix: (2-priority):u8, due:u64BE, E(id),E(partition),E(state),E(type). Priority must be0..2; all four opaque fields may be empty as mathematical bounds. Physical byte comparison equals DueOrder's priority DESC, due then raw id/partition/state/type ASC.
- FIFO prefix: E(group),E(recovery),E(tenant),E(type),E(state),E(partition). Suffix: score:u8 (0 running/-1,1 queued/0), sequence:u128BE, E(id). Only those two score tags. Full key ordering equals (LaneKey,LaneOrder); no float/u64 sequence conversion or follower scan.
- History prefix: E(group),E(recovery),E(tenant),E(partition),E(id). Suffix: event_ms:u64BE, E(ORIGINAL event_id). A shared allocation-free parser requires canonical unsigned-u64 decimal ms-version, no leading zeros except0, exactly one hyphen, no signs/trailing text/overflow. Encoder compares suffix version to event.version; decoder checks encoded numeric score equals parsed prefix. Mathematical version0 is accepted if matching, and is not asserted to be generated by a successful reducer. All u64 values are supported without the separate public cursor MAX_EXACT ceiling. Equal-ms100-10 sorts before100-2; numeric version and occurred_at do not participate in the key.

All decoder namespaces and expected lane/partition/id are compared as borrowed decoded streams before constructing any component owner. Decode order: positive caps, actual encoded cap, magic/version/family, complete canonical escape/scalar framing and exact EOF, expected namespace/selector and scalar/canonical-ID validation, checked128+decoded-component-sum and its separate cap, then ONE fallible exact logical reservation and copies. Due/FIFO own four raw components, history one. On refusal no returned owner or partial coordinates escape. The caller retains any old position until its real replacement; this batch certifies only the new output/scratch cap, never free old/new overlap. Unknown magic/family/escape follower/score tag is UnsupportedTag; version is UnsupportedVersion; truncation/unterminated escape/trailing is Malformed; namespace, bad priority or invalid canonical ID is InvalidValue; size conversion/checked sum is LengthOverflow. Limit carries the actual measured bytes and corresponding supplied maximum. Encode validates borrowed operands, measures exact bytes, cap-checks, and performs ONE fallible output Vec reservation. No native capacity equality is claimed.

FWSH value version1 grammar: magic FWSH,u16BE1; RAW(group),RAW(recovery),RAW(tenant),RAW(partition),RAW(id),RAW(event_id); kind:u8 from the EXISTING13-tag table; occurred_at,version,fence,attempts:u64BE; RAW(state); optional next_run_at; lease_deadline:u64BE; optional RAW(worker); optional RetryHistory. RAW is u32BE length plus unchanged bytes. All options are0 absent /1 plus payload, preserving Some(empty). Retry payload is decision:u8(0 Scheduled,1 Exhausted),RAW(run_state),optional next_run_at,max_retries:u16BE,backoff_kind:u8(0 None,1 Fixed,2 Linear,3 Exponential),base_ms,max_ms:u64BE,jitter_pct:u8,RAW(exhausted_to). Full framing/EOF and namespace/borrowed canonical-ID/version checks precede any field copy. Present retry policy uses the existing borrow-only validate_retry(Some(max),Some(backoff),Some(target)); no temporary RetryOverride/target clone. Preserve all other represented scalar/Option values rather than invent lease/attempt/decision cross-field constraints. The owner is mathematical typed data, not source-origin/current-record authority. Field constructors move fallibly copied Vecs; existing legacy allocation behavior is not strengthened to universal recoverable OOM. Encoding measures actual option widths before one output reserve. Wire cap is explicit; no new global/default history budget or public history-query admission is implied. Fixed wire overhead excluding raw payloads and present-option extras is78B.

## M2-PHYSICAL-FORMATS1 PARSER-PRECISION1

One shared ordinary helper is defined in EXISTING wf-storage/src/state/value.rs: pub(super) fn canonical_history_position(bytes:&[u8])->Result<(u64,u64),StateValueError>. It returns (event_ms,version), accepts exactly canonical unsigned-u64 decimal ms-version (including mathematical0), and returns InvalidValue for signs, missing/extra separators, leading zeros or numeric overflow. No allocation, UTF8 normalization, MAX_EXACT clamp or occurred_at access. New value/history.rs and sibling state/key/ordered.rs reuse this same body through normal parent visibility; the key/history encoders and history value checker compare the returned version to event.version. The history-key decoder additionally compares stored score to returned event_ms before ownership; a valid canonical ID has no escaped NUL, while any such byte makes the borrowed span invalid before copying. This adds no type or public free API. Also clarify that decoded Vec reserve is exactly the raw component-byte sum; fixed128 participates only in the separately checked logical owner cap, never as unused Vec payload capacity.

EXACT SIX new models (no other alias/type/callback API):
1. Private workflow-visible IndependentProfile enum{Transition,Terminal,Indexed}; only the Indexed variant admits all EIGHT existing mutations: Create/Transition/Complete/Fail/plain Retry/RetryWithPolicy/ExtendLease/Cancel, never Claim/Reclaim. Old wrappers select their unchanged old whitelists. This is a closed algorithm discriminator, not serialized authority/payment.
2. Private workflow-visible IndependentStep<E> enum{Item(Result<TransitionPlan,E>),Rejected(BatchRejection)}. Item contains only per-item business result; Rejected means discard ALL provisional owners. Operational ApplyError stays the outer Result.
3. Private workflow-visible IndependentResults<'input,E>{results:Vec<Result<ScopedPlan,E>>,latest:BTreeMap<ScopedRecordId<'input>,usize>}. It packages the SAME existing result/latest owners so the indexed constructor can consume final indices without rebuilding a key map. Old wrappers drop latest and move results into their existing public container. Keys borrow original BatchItems only.
4. Private IndependentIndexState<'query,'current>{authority:IndexedAuthority<'query,'current>,order:EntryOrder,limits:AdmissionLimits,count:usize,ordering:Vec<Option<(OrderingMetadata,StateMode)>>,consumed:u32}. The metadata Vec is construction scratch aligned with every result, None for error/noop and Some only for a real write. Prior-success index resolves scalar metadata while the actual predecessor record is borrowed from the owning results Vec.
5. Public IndependentIndexedPlan<'current>{results:Vec<Result<ScopedPlan,IndexRejection>>,finals:Vec<(usize,EXISTING OrderingChange<'current>)>,order:EntryOrder,consumed:u32}. Reuse old OrderingChange before/before_mode/after/after_mode; before borrows ONLY original canonical current (or None for original absence), never an intermediate result. A final index refers into owned results. All histories remain in their original successful ScopedPlans; no history/core payload Vec or clone is introduced. Clone/Debug/Eq/PartialEq match existing IndexedBatchPlan compatibility; the algorithm itself does not clone these payload owners and caller-held clones are external to its per-call bound.
6. Public IndependentIndexedDecision<'current> enum{Accepted(IndependentIndexedPlan<'current>),Rejected(IndexRejection)}, with the same derives. Whole batch/admission/profile refusals map to IndexRejection::Batch; per-item errors use existing IndexRejection, without a new error table/status model.

ONE new public API: decide_touched_independent_indexed_batch<'current>(view:TouchedIndexedGroupView<'_,'current>,items:&[IndexedBatchItem<'_>],order:EntryOrder,encoded_entry:&[u8],limits:AdmissionLimits)->Result<IndependentIndexedDecision<'current>,ApplyError>. Domain empty input returns Accepted empty plan/consumed0; old atomic empty behavior stays exact and future V6 frames remain nonempty. No synthetic partial GroupView or projection map is constructed.

EXACT plan accessors: results(&self)->&[Result<ScopedPlan,IndexRejection>]; into_results(self)->Vec<Result<ScopedPlan,IndexRejection>>; final_indices(&self)->impl ExactSizeIterator<Item=usize>+'_ ; originals(&self)->impl ExactSizeIterator<Item=Option<ClaimRecord<'current>>>+'_ ; metadata(&self)->impl ExactSizeIterator<Item=OrderingMetadata>+'_ ; deltas(&self)->impl ExactSizeIterator<Item=Result<IndexDelta<'_>,ApplyError>>+'_ ; history_plans(&self)->impl Iterator<Item=&ScopedPlan>+'_ ; consumed_ordinals(&self)->u32 and next_ordinal(&self)->Option<u32>. The FOUR final iterators use the SAME finals Vec in scoped-key order and have aligned lengths; results/history preserve INPUT order. history_plans includes EVERY successful real-write history, even when that record is later overwritten/cancelled. deltas resolves final record by index under a borrow of self and fails closed if the private invariant is broken. ExtendLease opt-in scalar route may be added only by an explicit precision; it is not silently part of this selection.

The initial core caller profile admits represented byte payload/result/error/reason, guards, requested times, retry override and partition meaning. Known valid-source but unrepresented features (named values/refs, attributes/state metadata, parent/root/correlation, retention/TTL/governance/history controls, internal schedule fields, rich record replies, arbitrary BEAM term values including the source map result) return explicit UnsupportedFeature BEFORE submit (whole refusal for Many, local slot for Pipeline). They are REQUIRED unported successors, not globally excluded or passing. Do not turn a BEAM map/nil into guessed opaque bytes. Original tuple/map/keyword/duplicate-key/Enumerable capture, ETF value/ref semantics, source setup/profile, atomic families, Create/Transition rich Many, default record-return ExtendLease, nonterminal pipeline commands, transport adapters and the full original hook cases remain required. The transport-neutral capture below is a new bounded typed scalar field capture, not an assertion that all original BEAM shapes were accepted.

NEW domain models in workflow::caller:

Create{workflow_type,state:&[u8],priority:u8,run_at_ms:Option<u64>,payload:Option<&[u8]>};
Transition{from,to:&[u8],fence:u64,lease_token:Option<&[u8]>,run_at_ms:Option<u64>,payload:Option<&[u8]>};
Complete/Fail{lease_token:&[u8],fence:u64,payload:Option<&[u8]>,value:Option<&[u8]>};
Retry{lease_token:&[u8],fence:u64,run_at_ms:Option<u64>,retry:Option<&RetryOverride>,payload/error:Option<&[u8]>};
ExtendLease{lease_token:&[u8],fence:u64,lease_ms:u64};
Cancel{fence:u64,lease_token:Option<&[u8]>,expected_state:Option<&[u8]>,expected_version:Option<u64>,reason:Option<&[u8]>}.
4. NormalizedMutation<'a> has PRIVATE id:&[u8],partition:Option<&[u8]>,requested_now_ms:Option<u64>,operation:CoreMutation<'a>; exact getters id(),partition(),requested_now_ms(),operation(). None partition means semantic auto; it is not a borrowed/generated self-reference. These are mathematical values, not proof of admission/origin/authorization.
5. PublicMutationEvidence {requested_now_ms:Option<u64>,auto_partition:bool,retry_override_present:bool}, Copy scalar caller-presence data. It is NOT a payment/authority flag.
6. MutationCallerError, Copy/Eq: InvalidOptions, InvalidId, MissingField(&'static str), InvalidField(&'static str), DuplicateField, UnknownField, UnsupportedFeature(&'static str), PartitionMismatch, EmptyMany, ItemLimit, RawBytes, LengthOverflow, Allocation. No secret caller values are formatted into errors.

normalize_core_mutation(input:MutationInput<'a>,common:&'a[(&'a str,MutationFieldValue<'a>)],base_partition:Option<&'a[u8]>,limits:AdmissionLimits,maximum_raw_bytes:usize)->Result<NormalizedMutation<'a>,MutationCallerError>. Common/per-item override selection is borrowed and explicit. The application ALSO performs a whole-call prospective read/count/byte pass; invoking this function repeatedly does not reset that call's budget.

Defaults/guards: queued state, priority0, lease30000; required nonempty binary id/type/states/token; reserved id/type and running destination rejection; source priority0..2; MAX_EXACT9007199254740991 on fence/times/version; positive lease and requested-now+lease deadline check. Create's source explicit requested_now default for absent run_at is preserved. Auto partition is CRC32(id)%256 rendered '__flow_auto__:' plus canonical decimal (Keys.ex890..896), using fixed <=16-byte scratch; not phash2, no metadata/record lookup. ONE required trait MutationSubmitPort:
prepare(&mut self,scope:&RequestScope,request:&RequestId,caller:&NormalizedMutation<'_>)->Result<CommittedTime,MutationNotSubmitted>;
submit(&mut self,scope:&RequestScope,request:&RequestId,prepared:PreparedBytes,workspace_limit:usize)->MutationSubmission.
No default success, generic operation trait, Tokio/engine type, read/StateStore capability or fake auth token. A port instance belongs to an actual authorized runtime context; prepare/submit must enforce current authorization and stable original placement/recovery at their respective stages, including after waits. Those checks are required contracts, NOT implemented authorization merely because an object exists. Command now = requested_now if supplied, otherwise admitted control execution time. Root's real-runtime M2/M3 integration remains required before production use.

NotSubmitted proves THIS attempt never reached proposal, not global nonexistence of another attempt. Unknown means bytes may still be owned/applied by supervised work: the port retains its resource/permit ownership until real completion, not merely until the waiting caller returns. Stop the call at first Unknown; mark every later slot NotSubmitted(PredecessorUnknown), no later prepare/submit. Definitive local/retained business errors can continue in source order. LogReplay alone is not a public retained result; a port must resolve the original retained owner or report Unknown. A recording port proves dispatch/classification only, never durable success.

### PUBLIC PRODUCER PROPOSAL PRECISION1 (supersedes only the named draft clauses)

This is a correction of the SAME UNSELECTED proposal1664ca62, preserving all30094 original bytes. No code/test/source release is inferred. Root/ARCH/PERF actual full reads found these finite schema/API/ownership details before any candidate body.

1. Source defaults: MutationAttrs117 and366 fill absent run_at_ms from explicitly supplied now for BOTH Create AND Transition. Normalization performs that fill BEFORE V1 hashing, frame measurement and effects; both absent remains None. Encoder/verifier reconstruct the same rule. Explicit Transition priority is an UnsupportedFeature in this core schema; it is never discarded. MutationCallerError additionally has InvalidLimits for malformed positive call profiles.

2. Exact pre-generation length API in the SAME new public_mutation facade/codec:
measure_public_mutation(scope:&RequestScope,request:&RequestId,caller:&NormalizedMutation<'_>,limits:CodecLimits)->Result<usize,RecordBatchApplyError>.
It validates the borrowed schema, exact frame/canonical lengths and relevant caps without hashing, allocating a frame, consulting time or making effects. Generated stamp/time fields have fixed widths. Application measures EVERY valid normalized item before its first prepare (Many any refusal is whole/pre-submit; Pipeline records local schema errors). This supplies E_i and G+2048+E_i before time generation, not a dummy stamp/encoder call or copied application size formula.
encode_public_mutation has the same draft arguments but RETURNS Result<(PreparedBytes,ClientIntent),RecordBatchApplyError>. The tuple returns the actual V1 intent calculated during that single encoding hash, so application need not hash again or parse its new frame to compare a reply. Encoder reruns shared validation/measurement for standalone correctness. The separately callable mathematical prepare_public_mutation_intent remains for comparison vectors/verifier reuse. No new owner/model/alias/trait/path.

3. Wire placement is explicit: the normal FWCP1 header contains root4, namespace/request, intent_version1/digest and admitted HLC/wall. AFTER that entire common header comes an EXTRA public_profile:u16BE=1, THEN evidence_flags:u8 and optional requested_now:u64BE, THEN one item. It is not the existing intent-version field counted twice. Thus common header75+H4=79, profile2+flags1+item35 yields E117 for the stated Complete. Effect now is requested_now if supplied, otherwise admitted HLC physical execution time, never wall time. Requested now is a source caller effect input; it does not set HLC/wall/control authority. Raw verifier checks that binding; Fresh verifies the public evidence against actual control execution for omitted now. Old private profiles still require their exact current control-time rule. A stale/unadmitted leader stamp is operational refusal, not a new clock authority or an invented scope.

4. Public response_version2 REPLACES the draft ambiguous rejection origin with three disjoint roots:
[0] = sole item success/noop;
[2,kind,code,detail?] = sole-item business rejection (same kind/code/detail grammar as a permitted V6 per-item row, but root2 replaces its leading1);
[1,kind,code,detail?] = whole-profile rejection, limited to Batch(Admission(...)) or Batch(CrossGroup).
Per-item Admission/CrossGroup/DuplicateId and whole item-domain/index-business tags refuse. An accepted mathematical plan with one Err therefore uses root2, not root1 or success.
